carry_distance_yds.name: carry_distance_yds
carry_distance_yds.points_at: This varies more shot to shot than measurement error explains, which points at timing rather than at anything fixed before the swing. Whether it is centered in the right place is a separate question, and this metric has no target to answer it against yet.
unavailable: no target for carry_distance_yds: how far a golfer should hit a given club is not a number this repo has. Every distribution here is cut from GolfDB, which contains no ball flight, and a tour carry band would judge an amateur against a population they are not in

face_to_path_deg.name: face_to_path_deg
face_to_path_deg.points_at: A miss that repeats at about the same size every swing. Whatever produces it is the same every time, which points at something already set before the swing starts rather than at something that happens during it. None of that is visible here, so the test is empirical: change one thing at setup, hit another set, and see whether the center moves.

finish_balance_norm.name: finish_balance_norm
finish_balance_norm.points_at: A miss that repeats at about the same size every swing. Whatever produces it is the same every time, which points at something already set before the swing starts rather than at something that happens during it. None of that is visible here, so the test is empirical: change one thing at setup, hit another set, and see whether the center moves.

flight_carry_yds.name: flight_carry_yds
unavailable: flight_carry_yds is not registered in METRIC_TARGETS, so there is no measurement error to judge either a bias or a spread against

head_sway_norm.name: head_sway_norm
head_sway_norm.points_at: Neither a repeatable miss nor scatter beyond what this instrument's own error explains. That is not a clean bill — it is that nothing here can be distinguished from noise at this sample size.

pivot_hip_axis_drift_norm.name: pivot_hip_axis_drift_norm
unavailable: pivot_hip_axis_drift_norm is not registered in METRIC_TARGETS, so there is no measurement error to judge either a bias or a spread against

start_line_deg.name: start_line_deg
start_line_deg.points_at: The miss moves shot to shot, which is not what a setup error looks like — anything fixed before the swing would produce the same error each time. Points at timing and release rather than at something checkable at address.

start_line_offline_yds.name: start_line_offline_yds
start_line_offline_yds.points_at: Both a repeatable miss and real shot-to-shot movement. Work the repeatable half first: it is checkable before you swing, and removing it makes what is left easier to read.

total_distance_yds.name: total_distance_yds
unavailable: no target for total_distance_yds: the same as carry, plus one more: the gap between them is roll, which is the ground rather than the swing - a target would judge a golfer for the mat they hit off

    flight_carry_yds           n = 12

    page: a session has many clubs, so there is no bulk backfill (ADR-024 §5).
